title: MineResourceCommand
description: Intent to perform ONE extraction at a deposit with the ship this session's actor is flying. The whole vocabulary is the deposit id: THE CLIENT CANNOT SAY HOW MUCH, WHICH MINERAL, FROM WHERE OR HOW FAR - the server derives the mineral from the deposit table, measures the distance from its own f64 ship position, and computes the yield deterministically (CLAUDE.md principle 1, spec p1-02 I-48). An injected quantity, mineral or position field is rejected by the schema and by serde as MALFORMED_COMMAND, not ignored. One accepted command changes the inventory at most once, across sessions, reconnects and server restarts: command_id is the durable idempotency key (ADR-0013 section 3, I-52). Judgement order and reject reasons: spec p1-02 section 4.2. Responses: exactly one COMMAND_RESULT, then - only when accepted, in the same tick - one INVENTORY_STATE (spec p1-02 section 5.1a).

deposit_id.description: Row of the DEPOSIT data table to extract from. A well-formed id that names no deposit in the ship's star system is rejected with TARGET_UNKNOWN, not MALFORMED_COMMAND: the shape is valid, the target is not.
